problem: An isolated reproduction showed the artifact gate admitted token savings even when every candidate trial failed or every success was unverified.
change: Require at least one verified-success candidate record for admission and expose the missing-evidence reason. Real verified recovery can still qualify; failures remain in the paired denominator.
validation: 43 passing assertions in tests/test_policy_evaluation.py, including cheaper failures, unverified claims, verified recovery and mixed outcomes. Evidence experiments/product/policy-evidence-floor/results.json and checks.log. Edited files pass git diff --check.
limitations: The evaluator trusts supplied trial records; this does not authenticate their evidence or provide a sufficient production-quality threshold. Artifact gate only, no model/service/deployment changes and no autonomous evolution. Main SESSION_STATE remains untouched.
